introHtml: Hand wash only towels are ideal for promotional products that require a softer, more delicate fabric. Made from materials like microfiber or cotton blends, these towels maintain their texture and absorbency when cared for properly. Perfect for spa giveaways, gym kits, or hospitality gifts, they offer a premium feel that stands out. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery to create a lasting impression.
